articles.description:
☕ @EspressoSys kicks off Build and Brew this week - Espresso's first global hackathon!
With $100,000 in rewards + opportunity for future incubation & seed funding, this is your chance to make Ethereum composable again! The hackathon is open to developers of all skill levels, with guaranteed prizes for any developer who completes the Caffeinate & Code track!
☕️ Learn how Espresso works under the hood
☕️ Deploy your first Espresso-Arbitrum Rollup
☕️ Contribute to the future of cross-chain composability
☕️ Get rewarded for your work - all deployed rollups qualify for a share of the prize pool
☕️ Compete for over US$100,000+ in prizes!
Register here before March 10: https://dorahacks.io/hackathon/build-and-brew/
